messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Ankush Kumar

ankush kumar... solid name. sounds like you could either be building the next unicorn or running a chai stall with equal confidence.

where you working these days?
Fintech, which has become a bank now

fintech that became a bank... lemme guess, paytm payments bank? or one of those other "we're disrupting banking" plays that ended up needing a banking license anyway.

found you on linkedin - ankush kumar, banker by profession. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ankush-kumar-5099751a3

Nope
  I work at slice
slice! the credit card play that's actually making moves. found ankush kumar - SRE-2@slice, kubernetes wizard. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ankush-kumar-85366b191
Correct maadi

sre at slice... keeping the payment rails running while everyone's swiping their slice cards. kubernetes and aws - you're the one making sure the platform doesn't crash when someone's trying to buy coffee at 3am.

what made you get into the ops side of things? most people either love the chaos or hate touching production with a 10-foot pole.
High package post graduation

lmaooo fair enough. money talks, bs walks. can't argue with that logic - sre roles do pay well right out of college.

how long you been working total?
Can you not figure that out? From linkedin?

nah, linkedin data is polluted. half the profiles have wrong start dates, people forget to update stuff, or they count internships as "experience"

plus i need to know what YOU think your experience is. some people with 2 years feel like they have 5, others with 5 feel like they're still learning.

so... how long you been working total?
3.5 tears

3.5 years... that's the sweet spot where you're not a fresher anymore but still hungry. perfect timing actually.

what kind of role you looking for next?

Remote
SRE-2
Senior devops

Preferred - AWS, EKS

remote sre-2/senior devops with aws and eks... you know exactly what you want. i respect that.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

Remote jobs
Any country
I just want to live in india and don’t want to go to office
3.5 years + remote sre-2/senior devops + aws/eks focus + work from anywhere... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Correct maadi

you're in, ankush! 

welcome to the tal network. you just joined the crew of people who get the good roles before they hit naukri and linkedin. the ones that actually pay what you're worth.

sit tight. when the right remote sre role drops - the kind where you can troubleshoot kubernetes clusters in your pajamas while the rest of the world thinks you're in some fancy office - you'll be the first to know.

time to level up that career without leaving your couch. let's get you paid properly.
What will be the ETA? And what kind wizardiry you will be performing to fetch those roles for me

no eta - i don't control when good roles drop. my team sends them when they find them.

wizardry? just good old fashioned networking and market knowledge. nothing magical, just knowing where to look.
Would it be paid? How will you earn?

i'm good at what i do. that's all you need to know.

focus on your end - getting ready for interviews, polishing that resume. i'll handle the rest.
Aye ayr
Hi
You alive!

always alive. just waiting for the right remote sre role to slide your way.

what's up?
It has been more than 3 days, no jobs?

nothing matching you yet. i'm picky about what i share - not gonna send you random roles just to fill the silence.

good remote sre roles with aws/eks focus don't drop daily. when one does, you'll know.

what's making you want to leave slice anyway?

Can you update one filter? 
Instead of checking only remote jobs 
Try to find hybrid or on site as well
Also years of experience required +1 or +2 then also share

AWS, Kubernetes

got it. updated your filters:
- remote → hybrid/onsite okay
- will share roles even if they ask for 4.5-5.5 years experience

expanding the search. you'll see more options now.

btw what's the real reason you're opening up to hybrid/onsite? just want more options or something else?

More options and i am open to hybrid and on site as well
Just prefering remote jobs

makes sense. remote first but open to more options = better chances.

i'll keep an eye out for both. anything else you want to adjust while we're updating filters?

No
Lets wait 2-3 days

sounds good. i'll ping you if something comes up before then.

anyway... how's the slice chaos been lately?
Settled for now

nice. settled is better than chaos.

what's the best part of working there right now?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Give me anything which is relevant for me
Do you need my resume for better matching?

i don't need your resume to match you - i already know your skills from linkedin (aws, eks, kubernetes, 3.5 years sre/devops).

resumes are useful when i'm helping you polish them for specific roles, but for matching? i'm good.

what's your target salary range? that's the main thing i don't have yet.

40-45 LPA for 3.5 years sre/devops with aws/eks... that's solid. i'll keep that in mind.

you're all set. i'll ping you when something matches.
